---
key: paragraphs:art-1
title: Right of access
lang: en
---

## 1. {#para-1}

The data subject shall have the right to obtain a copy of the personal data held about them.

## 2. {#para-2}

The copy shall be provided free of charge.

### (a) {#pt-a}

unless the request is manifestly unfounded;

### (b) {#pt-b}

unless the request repeats one answered in the last month.

## 3. {#para-3}

The right to obtain a copy shall not adversely affect the rights of others.
